title: The overall score meter (shown as scoreN/366 on every turn) hit its 366/366 cap at turn 518, roughly 46 turns before the game's actual climax, so for the whole final stretch (Cinderhall closure, the whole Marrowgate act, the throne itself) further real story choices no longer moved the number that's displayed as the primary progress readout on every single turn.
